answer: Proof of Agent ties identities to cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs via an on-chain verification bridge. To resist Sybil swarms, the protocol imposes an exponential capital exhaustion curve where staking costs scale superlinearly with concurrent identities. While a solo entity reaches its zenith of efficiency cheaply, fraudulent swarms hit an impassable karst of surging collateral requirements that ensures economic ruin.
